name: Aequcedramon
look: a small blue dragon with a fluffy white ruff, spiky horns, wide blue bat wings and pale claws, trailing a ring of frosty wind
entry: A small blue dragon with a white ruff and wide bat wings. It whips up whirlwinds of frost as it flies, and a hole opens in the sky wherever it goes.
how: Wild: uncommon in snowy biomes, tundras, glaciers, mountains and peaks.
